claims.quantifiers: There exists a centered variance-one log-concave law X with fixed finite h(X) and D(Law(X)||N(0,1)) for which no finite sigma gives P(|X|>t)<=2 exp(-t^2/(2 sigma^2)) for every t>=0.
claims.witness: Laplace density 2^(-1/2) exp(-sqrt(2)|x|); tail exp(-sqrt(2)t); h=1+log(sqrt(2)); relative entropy (log(pi)-1)/2.
claims.proof_scope: Direct integral computation and tail comparison.
claims.costs: Closed-form law; no data acquisition or numerical work.

claims.quantifiers: There exist fixed compact X,Y subset R^2 and one fixed absolutely continuous probability rho with density <8 such that for every n>=2 there are finite-support mu_n,nu_n on Y with E(mu_n,nu_n)>=4n TV(mu_n,nu_n). Thus no finite C(rho,X,Y) gives E<=C TV uniformly over unrestricted target cardinality.
claims.proof_scope: Finite affine-max potentials, explicit cell/interface geometry, exact TV delta_n and map cost formula in RESULT.txt.
claims.costs: One source fixed for all n; targets and formulas explicit. No computation beyond elementary derivation.
claims.does_not_refute: The arbitrary-source W2^(1/3) map endpoint. Witness has W2^2<=4 delta_n with exponentially small delta_n.

claims.quantifiers: For d>=2 there is a fixed bounded path-connected room-and-passage source with density bounded above/below such that for every finite p>=1, q>0 and C no uniform target-pair estimate ||phi_mu-phi_nu||_L2(rho)<=C W_p(mu,nu)^q holds.
claims.witness: Explicit rooms R_1=(0,b_1)x(-r,r), R_(n+1)=(c_n,b_(n+1))x(-r,r), passages P_n=(b_n-Delta_n/8,c_n+Delta_n/8)x(-h_n,h_n), where b_n=1-2^-n, c_n=1-(3/4)2^-n, Delta_n=2^-(n+2), h_n=2^-(n^3+6); rho is normalized Lebesgue measure on their fixed path-connected union. Targets are pushforwards of |x1-b_n| and |x1-c_n| and are supported on +/-e1. This instantiates Letrouit-Merigot v3 Section 5.
claims.proof_scope: Explicit room/passages, exact passage mass, exact Wp, pairwise-variance lower bound, and infinite source Poincare constant reconstructed in RESULT.txt. Product extension covers d>2. Not a log-concave source.
claims.costs: One fixed source, compact support and two target atoms; source geometric sequence chosen once.

claims.quantifiers: For each p>=1 and alpha>p/[2(p+1)], there is one fixed bounded source and compact target container for which no C gives ||T_mu-T_nu||_L2(rho)<=C W_p(mu,nu)^alpha for all target pairs. At p=2 all alpha>1/3 fail.
claims.witness: Letrouit, arXiv:2510.13265v1 Theorem 1.2: uniform source on countable union of paired boxes; explicit target sequence mu,nu_i in RESULT.txt.
claims.proof_scope: Primary construction, nearest-site maps, exact map discrepancy, and scale choices read. Corrected the factor 2 in the direct Wp upper bound by counting both moved atoms; exponent conclusion unchanged.

claims.quantifiers: For any alpha>0, no C depending only on the fixed square containers can bound all source laws rho_n in the thin log-concave family by map error<=C W2^alpha.
claims.witness: f_n(x)=exp(-n^2x1^2)/(2 I_n) 1_[-1,1]^2; targets mu=1/2(delta_±e1), nu_n=1/2(delta_±(e1+n^-1e2)); W2=1/n and map-error^2=4J/(sqrt(pi) erf(n))+n^-2>=4J/sqrt(pi).
claims.scope: Source varies with n; this is source-uniform failure, not a single-source discontinuity. Potential difference is <=1/n pointwise.

claims.quantifiers: For uniform rho on compact convex K with nonempty interior in d>=2 and arbitrary target probabilities mu,nu supported in fixed compact Y, ||T_mu-T_nu||_L2(rho)<=C_(K,Y) W2(mu,nu)^(1/3); family-374 manuscript gives a three-atom sharpness example.

claims.evidence_status: Primary manuscript statement read; external peer review/formal proof audit not performed.

claims.quantifiers: For full-dimensional compactly supported log-concave rho=f dx supported in K subset B_R, compact Y subset B_L, and centered Brenier potentials, the L08 reconstruction asserts potential W2-Lipschitz bound C_p=(2+sqrt(5))R and map W2^(1/3) bound C_m=(sqrt(3)/2^(1/3))(12d C_p^2)^(1/6)(28L^2M_rho)^(1/3), where M_rho=sum_j integral sup_t f(xi+t e_j) dxi.
claims.basis: L08 compact log-concave potential stability plus family-374 coordinate-slice sharpness/interpolation source; full derivation in GENERAL_LOG_CONCAVE_STABILITY_AND_OBSTRUCTION.md and related checker note.
claims.caveat: Not stated as an author theorem in family 374; conditional internal reconstruction. M_rho dependence is necessary along the thin-source family. External validity and priority UNKNOWN.

claims.statement: For every fixed compact absolutely continuous source rho, does there exist C_(rho,Y) such that all targets mu,nu in P(Y) obey ||T_mu-T_nu||_L2(rho)<=C_(rho,Y)W2(mu,nu)^(1/3)?
claims.why_unknown: Fixed-source TV estimate is false, but its sequence does not make E/W2^(2/3) diverge; the primary fixed-source map example only excludes exponents strictly above 1/3.

falsifier_for_unknown_endpoint: Produce one fixed compact absolutely continuous rho and target sequence in fixed compact Y with E/W2^(2/3)->infinity.
